highlights: My seeds folds each crop into a group that starts closed: tap a crop to open it, or use Expand all. A search or filter opens the groups it matches

Seed cards lead with the supplier as a coloured chip, with a matching stripe down the card (each supplier has its own colours), plus a small packet picture from the supplier; a new supplier filter narrows the list
A Hottest sort lists peppers by Scoville range, hottest first, using the seller's figure where one is published and a best guess marked "est." where it isn't

Opening a seed shows its packet picture large (tap to enlarge) with its heat, country of origin, species, days to maturity, breeding and a link to the packet's page; on a seed's form, Origin now reads Supplier and Source URL reads Packet page (URL)
The − / + count is gone from the seed cards; change a packet's count as Qty on hand on its own page
The variety list and picker now show all your cultivars; they stopped at 500
